name: Gasfuli for Business
imageAlt: Gasfuli LPG depot dashboard shown on a laptop
description: Cloud-based platform giving LPG brands complete supply chain visibility.
longDescription: Gasfuli is a cloud-based platform giving LPG brands complete supply chain visibility. It transforms cylinders into digital assets using QR identities for real-time traceability, then tracks refill, dispatch, and delivery to eliminate loss, mitigate unauthorized refills, and support total accountability and revenue assurance.
